FRAY's main cover reads as placeholder geometry, and RIFT's jungle and centre are sparse for a flagship. These are majors, not blockers, so the item stays ON PAR at the bar, with E2 and E3 in the backlog. Frame timing: not measured (load above 3). No sensitivity issue was found in the environment.

findings.title: FRAY hour stones are untextured dark slabs that read as lidded caskets
findings.what: The ten hour stones on the Noonplate are chamfered dark boxes. Each has a lid seam and a pale chalk stripe, and the top surface is flat. They are FRAY's main cover.
findings.evidence: Re-captured by the verifier in _harness/_shots/closing2_envv_fray_at0.png and at1.png. Same look in the reviewer's closing2_env_fray_nf_at3.png and at4.png. closing2_env_boxstats.jsonl: hourstone_in2/in3/in4 hp 0.43/0.58/0.62, L* p5-p95 about 21-23.8. hour_stone.glb last changed in d7359354f (W5a).
findings.fix: Rebuild the hour stone as a VALE dial-marker: stepped, offset basalt courses with a gnomon-shaped top and no lid seam; an inked hour channel cut into the top; chipped arrises and a chalk-dust skirt; in-game hp at least 2.8; keep L* 20-28. Add it to the value_probe landmark hp gate.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced. Major is the right severity: this is the main cover in every FRAY frame and it is not a sensitivity item. The coffin read is a judgement call, but at gameplay zoom it reads as an untextured primitive (gauge: LoL cover has painted value breakup).

findings.title: Landmark finish is speckle noise; Seat empty, jungle single-species, shadow-slab cap a white lid
findings.what: The rebuilt numerals and VI slab carry uniform high-frequency speckle, not painted wear, and the VI reads as a framed signboard. The shadow-slab cap is a smooth white lid. The Seat is a bare disc with blotchy ring staining. The jungle is one Dialwood crown at one scale.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing2_env_rift_nf_at0.png (XI, crown carpet), at4.png (VI signboard), at6.png (Seat: seat_centre hp 1.66, ring hp 2.43), at8.png (shadowslab_cap L* p50 63.5, luma 154). All viewed by the verifier; numbers match closing2_env_boxstats.jsonl.
findings.fix: Use a painted-stone material: base-to-top ramp, chipped edges capped at L* 48, grime at the base, half the speckle. Re-cap the shadow slab at L* 40 or below. Give the VI a weathered numeral without the frame. Add a flush walkable centrepiece to the Seat. Author 2-3 Dialwood variants at ±20 % scale plus an undergrowth layer at L* 45 or below.
